This covers login and storage well. The answer is clear already.

**Login:** `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts:16`) — no server auth; it loads/creates `localStorage["ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>"]`, sets it as the active profile under key `ai_dnd_user`, exposed via the `profile` signal. `isLoggedIn()` (`:12`) just checks `profile() !== null`; `auth.guard.ts` gates routes on it.

**Campaigns:** Stored client-side only, in `UserProfile.campaigns` (an array of `CampaignSlot`) inside those same `localStorage` keys. Each slot holds `sessionId` + `characterId` pointing at server state — the actual game data lives in Workers KV (`session:<sessionId>`, 7-day TTL) and D1 tables `characters`, `character_inventory`, `adventure_log` (permanent). Managed via `addCampaign`/`updateCampaign`/`removeCampaign` (`auth.service.ts:36,44,54`).

**Deleting a slot:** `removeCampaign` (`auth.service.ts:54`) only removes the `CampaignSlot` from the local profile/`localStorage`. It does **not** call any Worker endpoint — the D1 character row, inventory, adventure log, and KV session all remain on the server, just orphaned with no local link to them.
